title: BRIDGING THE DATA PROVENANCE GAP ACROSS TEXT, SPEECH, AND VIDEO

bias_targets.methodology: Mapping dataset creator organizations to their headquartered countries and calculating Gini coefficients over time to measure the statistical dispersion, concentration, and inequality of geographic representation in multimodal training datasets.

Analyzing dataset metadata for ISO 639 language codes and Glottolog language families, and computing Gini coefficients over time to quantify the concentration and inequality of linguistic representation in text and speech data.
